data.title: Weather Forecast for Sunday
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) forecasts thunderstorms, accompanied by active winds in parts of Jazan, Aseer, Al-Baha, and Makkah regions. Fog may form in parts of these regions and the coastal parts of Eastern Region.
    Over the Red Sea, winds will be northwesterly to northerly at speeds of 10–36 km/h in the northern part, northwesterly to northeasterly at speeds of 10–32 km/h in the central part, and southerly to southeasterly at speeds of 12–42 km/h in the southern part.
    In the Arabian Gulf, winds will be northwesterly to northerly at speeds of 10–32 km/h in the northern part and northwesterly to southwesterly at speeds of 10–30 km/h in the southern part.
    -- SPA
07:07 Local Time 04:07 GMT
